verdict.rationale: n8n natively supports webhook triggers and 1500+ app integrations, enabling workflows to fire on events like new records, messages, emails, or form submissions, backed by docs and community usage (e.g., subreddit scraping, webhook-initiated tasks). missing for 10: independent benchmarking of specific app-event triggers (e.g., new record in CRM) beyond generic webhook/integration docs, and more first-party documentation per-trigger-type reliability.
